entities.summary: Beyazıt State Library is a book depositary and digital library in Istanbul. One of Turkey's oldest libraries, it is the first national library of Ottoman manuscripts and one of the country's six legal deposit libraries. Beyazıt State Library is a library in Asia, established in 1884. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
